Grants an additional <strand/>Frenzied Blade Ability Charge.

<strand/>Frenzied Blade or <strand/>Flechette Storm Hits grant a Stack of 'Wish-Dragon's Talons' for ? seconds. Maximum of 3? Stacks.

Can only grant 1 Stack per ability usage.

'Wish-Dragon's Talons' grants increased <strand/>Frenzied Blade and <strand/>Flechette Storm damage.

Damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• <strand/>Frenzied Blade: 20% | 50% | 100%
• <strand/>Flechette Storm: 10% | 25% | 50%

<strand/>Banner of War's Pulses grant 5% <strand/>Frenzied Blade Ability Energy and an additional 5% for each ally within 10 meters.
